text: Reputation is Sybil-resistant in a way token holdings are not: a strategic actor can acquire tokens by purchase but cannot acquire reputation without making contributions that other contributors will reference favorably.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6819121

isBasedOn.name: The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis

abstract: a strategic actor can acquire token holdings by purchasing tokens, but a strategic actor cannot acquire reputation without making contributions that the rest of the protocol's contributors will reference favorably.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: reference-weighted reputation in the WDAG architecture
